items.title: Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2022
items.q: the background singer coach was this guy named Luther, Luther Vandross

ctx.x: Right. And Jerry Bergonzi and also the background singer coach was this guy named Luther, Luther Vandross. And that record never even came out because the guy that was head of Columbia A&R, Mickey Eichner, was a complete idiot. I hope he hears this someday — oh he’s probably gone. But he was totally threatened to have Bob James on Tappan Zee Records come into the Columbia label fold. So just by bad luck the first project he could kill to show Bob James who had more power, it was our record. So despite it being…
Not a bad solution to that problem.
